summary: Neighbors gather at a church to see delegates and their alternates onto the buses.
realLife: An August 1964 report placed the Freedom Democrats’ departure at Pratt Memorial Methodist Church in Jackson, where supporters sang as the buses left for Atlantic City.
gates: A delegation has arranged group travel from a community meeting point.
